name: Marker
tagline: Fast open-source PDF-to-Markdown and JSON converter with strong table, equation, and layout accuracy.
real_test_summary: Tested converting research papers and technical manuals into Markdown locally with equations and tables intact. Runs offline in batch mode across local document folders.
pros: Strong conversion accuracy for tables, math equations, and code blocks
Supports batch folder processing completely offline
Outputs clean Markdown ready for local knowledge bases
cons: GPU acceleration speeds up large PDF batches significantly
GPL-3.0 license requires careful review for closed-source embedding
